children: Enova withdrew its bank regulatory applications for the proposed Grasshopper acquisition and reaffirmed 2026 guidance while planning accelerated share repurchases.
Withdrew applications with the OCC and Federal Reserve for the proposed acquisition of Grasshopper Bancorp.
Company says regulators lack clear standards for nonbanks seeking to become banks, citing political pressure risks.
Reaffirms Q3 outlook: ~25% revenue growth and ~30% adjusted EPS growth year-over-year.
Maintains full-year 2026 outlook: 20–25% revenue growth and 30–35% adjusted EPS growth.
Intends to accelerate share repurchases; $218M available under senior note covenants and $349M under board authorization (as of June 30, 2026).

title: Enova withdraws bank applications, reaffirms 2026 guidance and to accelerate buybacks
